name: The MediVasc Journal
intro: Plain-spoken guidance on diabetic feet, circulation, wounds and swollen limbs — written to help you act early and keep walking.

categories.name: Diabetic foot
categories.intro: Diabetes can quietly dull the nerves and narrow the blood vessels of the feet. These articles explain the early signs, the daily checks and when a small problem needs a doctor the same day.
categories.metaDescription: Diabetic foot care explained simply: warning signs, daily foot checks, footwear and when to see a doctor — practical guidance from MediVasc, Delhi.

categories.name: Circulation & PAD
categories.intro: Peripheral arterial disease narrows the arteries that feed the legs. Learn what leg pain on walking can mean, how circulation is checked and what helps.
categories.metaDescription: Peripheral arterial disease (PAD) and leg circulation in plain words: symptoms, tests, walking, risk factors and when to seek care.

categories.name: Wound care
categories.intro: A wound that is slow to heal is a signal, not a nuisance. Practical guides on dressings, pressure, infection signs and getting the right help early.
categories.metaDescription: Non-healing wounds and foot ulcers: how to care for them at home, signs of infection, offloading and when a wound needs specialist attention.

categories.name: Lymphoedema
categories.intro: Long-standing swelling of an arm or leg — including filarial elephantiasis — can be managed. Daily habits, skin care and compression, explained step by step.
categories.metaDescription: Lymphoedema and elephantiasis explained: causes, skin care, compression, exercise and daily habits that help control limb swelling.

categories.name: Prevention & daily care
categories.intro: Small, steady habits protect feet and legs over years. Routines, checklists and questions to take to your next appointment.
categories.metaDescription: Everyday prevention for feet and legs: foot-care routines, footwear, walking, check-up checklists and questions to ask your doctor.

authors.name: MediVasc
authors.bio: MediVasc works with people across India to help protect feet and legs from the complications of diabetes, poor circulation and long-standing swelling.
